description: This source file defines the class ProgressiveEMICalculator, which implements the EMICalculator interface. It contains logic for generating and managing interest and repayment schedules for progressive loan products with EMI calculations, including handling interest rate changes, disbursements, principal and interest payments, and schedule recalculations. The class interacts heavily with loan schedule models, repayment periods, interest periods, and various schedule adjustment operations.

classes.name: ProgressiveEMICalculator
classes.description: This class implements complex interest and schedule calculation logic tailored for progressive loan products with EMI features, including handling varying interest methods, interest rates, and repayment schedules, as well as schedule adjustments for disbursements, payments, and interest rate changes.

methods.name: generatePeriodInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Generates an interest schedule model for given repayment periods including interest calculations based on loan product details.

methods.name: generateInstallmentInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Creates an interest schedule based on actual loan installments, filtering out down payments and additional installments before processing.

methods.name: findRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Finds the specific repayment period in the schedule model that corresponds to the given due date.

methods.name: addDisbursement
methods.description: Adds a disbursement amount to the schedule, updating interest periods accordingly based on the disbursement date.

methods.name: addCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Records and applies capitalized income at a specified transaction date.

methods.name: changeInterestRate
methods.description: Updates the interest rate on the schedule starting from a specific date.

methods.name: addRepaymentPeriods
methods.description: Adds additional repayment periods to the schedule model, recalculating interest and EMI values accordingly.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates a list of repayment periods in the schedule model, typically after schedule changes.

methods.name: generateAdditionalRepaymentPeriodDueDates
methods.description: Calculates due dates for additional repayment periods based on current schedule parameters.

methods.name: changeInterestRate
methods.description: Private method to change interest rate within the schedule, adjusting interest periods and EMI factors.

methods.name: addBalanceCorrection
methods.description: Corrects the outstanding loan balance at a specified date.

methods.name: payInterest
methods.description: Records interest payments made by the borrower, updating the schedule accordingly.

methods.name: payPrincipal
methods.description: Records principal payments made, adjusts the schedule, and handles schedule recalculations if necessary.

methods.name: getDueAmounts
methods.description: Returns the maximum due principal and interest amounts for a specified period and date.

methods.name: getPeriodInterestTillDate
methods.description: Calculates the interest amount due till a specific date for a given period.

methods.name: getOutstandingLoanBalanceOfPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the outstanding loan balance for a specific period up to a given date.

methods.name: calculateEMIOnActualModel
methods.description: Generates EMI calculations based on the actual repayment periods and schedule model, choosing the interest calculation method (flat or declining balance).

methods.name: calculateEMIOnActualModelWithDecliningBalanceInterestMethod
methods.description: Calculates EMI values using the declining balance interest method, adjusting each repayment period for the calculated EMI.

methods.name: calculateEMIOnNewModelAndMerge
methods.description: Creates a new schedule model with disbursements and capitalized income, then merges it into the existing schedule periods.

methods.name: applyInstallmentAmountInMultiplesOf
methods.description: Adjusts the calculated installment amount to be rounded to specified multiples, if applicable.

methods.name: getEmiAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates and returns an EMI adjustment object, reflecting the difference between the last and previous EMI periods.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorForScheduleTillDateInclusive
methods.description: Recalculates the interest rate factors for the schedule up to a specific date, updating interest periods.

methods.name: getPeriodWithUnrecognizedInterest
methods.description: Finds a repayment period with unrecognized interest, starting from the last unpaid period.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorPlus1N
methods.description: Calculates the product of rate factors plus one, used in EMI computations.

methods.name: calculateFnResult
methods.description: Sums up the Fn values across repayment periods for schedule calculations.

methods.name: calculateEMIValue
methods.description: Computes the EMI value based on rate factors and outstanding balance.

methods.name: rateFactorByRepaymentEveryDay
methods.description: Calculates the rate factor for daily repayments using simple interest formulas.

methods.name: rateFactorByRepaymentEveryWeek
methods.description: Calculates the rate factor for weekly repayments using simple interest formulas.

methods.name: rateFactorByRepaymentEveryMonth
methods.description: Calculates the rate factor for monthly repayments using simple interest formulas.

methods.name: rateFactorByRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the rate factor for a custom repayment period based on interest rate and days in month/year.

methods.name: rateFactorByRepaymentPartialPeriod
methods.description: Calculates rate factor adjustments for partial repayment periods.

methods.name: fnValue
methods.description: Calculates the function value (Fn) for a repayment period, used in EMI calculations.

methods.name: getSumOfDueInterestsOnDate
methods.description: Returns the total due interest on a specific date for the schedule model.

methods.name: applyInterestPause
methods.description: Applies an interest pause over a specified date range and recalculates interest rate factors.

methods.name: calculateRateFactorsForInterestPause
methods.description: Recalculates interest rate factors upon an interest pause, affecting schedule interest periods.

methods.name: getUncountablePeriods
methods.description: Counts repayment periods where the original EMI is less than the total paid amount, used for adjustment calculations.
